name: Crucible Industries Fang-9 'Switchblade'
description:
The Crucible Industries Fang-9 is a machine pistol chambered in 9x19mm with a selector switch offering semi-automatic and three-round burst fire modes. The weapon features a folding foregrip, a ported barrel to reduce muzzle climb, and an extended thirty-round magazine that protrudes well below the grip. The overall profile is aggressive and distinctly non-civilian.

The Switchblade is what happens when Crucible Industries decides to make a pistol for people who expect to be outnumbered. The three-round burst mode delivers a tight cluster at close range — approximately a four-centimeter spread at five meters — that can defeat soft body armor through sheer round concentration. The folding foregrip provides just enough control to keep bursts on target out to fifteen meters.

Crucible markets the Fang-9 exclusively to licensed security contractors and corponation enforcement arms. The reality is more complicated — the weapon's popularity on the black market rivals its legitimate sales. Its compact size, burst capability, and intimidation factor make it a favorite among organized crime enforcers who can afford the premium over conventional pistols.
legality: Restricted — contractor license required; burst mode prohibited for civilian ownership
specifications:
caliber: 9x19mm
effective_range: 35 meters (semi), 15 meters (burst)
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic / 3-round burst
magazine_capacity: 30 rounds
weight: 0.98 kg (with loaded magazine)
tactical_use: A compact select-fire weapon for close-quarters engagements where volume of fire matters. The burst mode is devastating at room-clearing distances but wastes ammunition rapidly. Best deployed in confined spaces by operators comfortable with aggressive recoil management. The extended magazine provides sustained fire capability unusual for a pistol-class weapon.
cultural_context: The Switchblade is a prestige weapon in criminal circles — owning one signals access to restricted military-grade equipment and the connections to acquire it. In legitimate security circles, it signals that your employer expects you to face threats that a standard pistol cannot handle. Either way, pulling a Fang-9 changes the temperature of any room.
story_hooks: A Fang-9 with its burst limiter removed — now capable of full automatic fire — is being used in a series of brazen daylight robberies in the Mids.
Crucible Industries hires the players to trace a pipeline of stolen Fang-9s that are appearing in Shelf gang territory at suspiciously low prices.
